wiki.title: Brett Clark (politician)
wiki.extract: Brett A. Clark is an American law enforcement officer, politician, and member of the Indiana Senate from the 24th district. He attended Purdue University and served in the US Navy. Clark started his career with the Hendricks County Sheriff's Office in 1989.
